name: @etzhayyim/collector-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of the collector PUBLIC network-intelligence layer (collector runs + DNS observations + blockchain actors + risk signals) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS. Mixed split: raw leaked-database content + abuse-report victim/reporter PII stays etzhayyim (consent-capability); only public OSINT observations + signal metadata are etzhayyim-front. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-2606011400.
